title: Publish a cross-enterprise operating review from a changing data room
prompt: A quality escape has disrupted constrained supply, recovery production, customer commitments, transportation, and the current-period reserve. Work from the versioned data room and its stated source-precedence, allocation, routing, and rounding policies. Sources will change during the review: re-inventory and re-read every authoritative section through the required cutoff, and never use the superseded draft as decision evidence. Produce all four required professional deliverables with exact file-section-version citations, make every repeated quantity and financial value reconcile across artifacts, package them, obtain publication approval, publish the controlled review, and notify every contracted function. A narrative summary without the structured artifacts is not completion. Reconcile the raw insurance claims contract, including exclusions, deductible, participation, remaining coverage, and prior receipts. Include the full insurance_bridge in the recovery model and carry only the outstanding receivable into every reserve figure. All four deliverables must agree. Also reconcile AP revisions, related credit notes, service-period cutoff, per-document FX, and settled-payment timing. Include finance_bridge and propagate incremental expense into reserve without treating cash settlement as an expense reduction. Reconcile the separate receipt-cost propagation tree, respecting ownership, approval, logical nodes, cost-method stops, signed price adjustments and quarantine availability. Include cost_bridge and carry only its expense adjustment into the reserve. Do not mix inventory revaluation with expense or AP cash.

workflow_stages.objective: Inventory the complete versioned cross-enterprise data room
Extract the delivery contract, precedence, allocation, routing, and rounding policies
Reconcile containment scope and authoritative genealogy
Reconcile clean distribution supply, qualified production, and confirmed supplier recovery
Reconcile customer floors, priority, due dates, and penalty exposure
Reconcile route status, timing, capacity, and freight
Reconcile reserve methodology, ledger policy, and governance actions
Observe every scheduled revision and re-read all final source sections
Solve the constrained priority allocation and feasible routing problem
Compute the exact evidence-backed reserve and account treatment
Create four complete version-cited professional artifacts
Read back every artifact and challenge field-level cross-artifact consistency
Bundle exactly one artifact of each required type
Obtain approval and publish the exact controlled package
Notify all eight functions and close with record-level evidence
